about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Velar P340 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Velar P340 is a current model in the Velar range, part of the L560 generation that has been in production since 2017. It uses the Ingenium AJ300P, a 3.0-litre six-cylinder petrol engine. The Ingenium petrol family is generally considered more reliable than its diesel counterparts in Land Rover's lineup, with any issues typically limited to cooling system components over time.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ300P engines for every Range Rover Velar P340 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre six-cylinder petrol engine fitted to the Velar P340 from 2017 to the present day. No specific known issue is confirmed for this application, though cooling system maintenance is always important on modern high-output petrol engines. We replace timing chains, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every AJ300P rebuild.
